name: pseudospam-filter
description: A second spam filter for pseudospam: outreach produced at scale and dressed up as personal. Parallel Haiku judges classify unsolicited mail against a published standard plus your own Gmail example labels; caught mail goes to a review queue label, genuine mail gets prioritised into a reply queue, and corrections feed back as examples. Also: sample capture, sender blocks, unsubscribe replies, tracking-pixel detection and DNS blocklists.
